column1: # What Wireshark shows of an IE of GTPv2-C, and what of the crate it is compared with
#   field  IE type, Wireshark's field, the member of the crate's tree of the value, and the
#          comparison; and a note where the two name the field otherwise. The member is `.`
#          for the tree itself, where it is a scalar; `A > B` for the member B of the
#          member A; `A | B` for A where Wireshark shows the field first and B where it
#          shows it next, of those of the two that the tree has; `A > * > B` for B of the
#          entry of the list A at the place where Wireshark shows the field. The comparison
#          is bool (a flag, which the tree has where it is set), int (a number, decimal or
#          0x), ip (an address), text (the same text), name (a coded value, by Wireshark's
#          label and the crate's name), hex (the octets), mcc or mnc (the MCC or the MNC of
#          the crate's PLMN, MCC-MNC), octet (a coded octet as it is written), or tbcd
#          (digits of TBCD, which Wireshark shows as ? where they are no decimal digit);
#   none   IE type (`*` for any), Wireshark's field (`*` for any that no other row of the
#          IE type names), and why it is compared with nothing;
#   value  Wireshark's field, a code, and the crate's name of it, where Wireshark labels the
# A field that no row names is counted in coverage.tsv as unlisted, and a spare field as spare.
